title: Memory Containers (Variables)
objectives: Understand what variables are and how to store data
Learn about different data types: Strings, Integers, Floats
description: Master variables, strings, numbers, and basic data types in Python. You'll learn how to store and manipulate data in your programs.

exercises.title: Clearance Check: Variable Concept
exercises.description: What is the primary purpose of a variable in Python?
options: To store data values for later use
To print text to the screen

exercises.title: Neural Sync: Agent Profile Initialization
exercises.description: CHRONOS PERSONNEL DATABASE: New operative 'Cipher' joining the ranks at Level 5 clearance with Active duty status. Initialize the agent's digital profile by storing their credentials in the system. Type the variable assignments exactly to register the operative in the mainframe.

exercises.title: Field Mission: Power Core Diagnostics
exercises.description: CHRONOS ENERGY SYSTEMS: Initialize the reactor core diagnostics module. The main power core is operating at 100% capacity. Store this critical value in the 'score' variable and output it to the monitoring terminal for verification.
